purpose: Reduce real-model QASC scoring orchestration time through global batching while proving equivalence to the frozen per-case scorer.

benchmark.selection_rule: lowest canonical SHA-256 of [selection_seed, case_id], then case_id
benchmark.warmup_rule: run the frozen per-case scorer once on the first prepared case outside the benchmark sample
benchmark.timing_order: warmup, per-case baseline, global batch 8, global batch 16, global batch 32

adoption_rule.selection: Among candidates passing every equivalence check and minimum speedup, select the lowest measured elapsed time, then smaller batch size.
adoption_rule.if_no_candidate_passes: Keep the frozen per-case scoring entrypoint and retain the negative optimization result.
adoption_rule.if_candidate_passes: Adopt only as a future score-generation entrypoint; do not rewrite the frozen QASC score artifact or confirmation.

gate_policy: This performance benchmark cannot change QASC NOT_CONFIRMED, Gate 2 NO-GO/SHADOW, the three-confirmation series, review ranking, or the MuSiQue boundary.
